text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian's slump continues. Concerned 
for her, Hishi Amazon believes she should 
focus on her own training for now and wait 
for her at the peak.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the Tenno Sho (Autumn), Narita Brian 
suffered a crushing defeat. Her loss of 
former glory sent shockwaves through the 
crowd, and the public's expectations began 
to fade...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, in an interview before the Japan 
Cup, Hishi Amazon states clearly that her 
rival remains the same as ever: Narita 
Brian—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon believed in Narita Brian's 
comeback. Her words seemed to sway the 
public's impression of Brian as well...!
